material.description: NASA Science, “Stars”, opening life-cycle summary and “Life” section (https://science.nasa.gov/universe/stars/): NASA states that stars have life cycles and their properties change as they age; the “Life” section gives examples of changes in luminosity, size and temperature during the main-sequence phase. This supports the Claim’s general life-cycle statement. Later evolutionary pathways vary with stellar mass, so the description does not imply one identical sequence for every star.
